newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SA Druggists buys rest of healthcare unit.
newsitem.headline: SA Druggists buys rest of healthcare unit.

text.p: South African Druggists Ltd said on Monday its Healthcare Management Services division had bought out the rest of its Medicross Clinic Chain and Medical Services Organisation unit for an undisclosed sum.
The 25 percent stake was purchased from minority partners.
The terms of the deal also include the sale of a 75 percent stake in Universal Healthcare Insurance to one of the minorities, Docter Walter Ward.
The group said 100-percent control of the acquired unit would allow it to be more easily integrated into the overall group and it would gain access to wider markets.
"Historically this was not possible due to the minority shareholding," SA Druggists said in a statement.
